intro: Miners' Gear consists of sturdy dwarven picks, shovels, and excavation tools stored within the Silver Stream Mine. Following an infestation of vermin, the Miners' League tasked adventurers with retrieving these valuable implements before local guards launched an assault.

p: When the Silver Stream Mine in eastern Loch Modan ran out of ore, the Miners' League repurposed the quiet tunnels into a subterranean storage depot for mining equipment. Unfortunately, tunnel-dwelling kobolds quickly overrun the complex, making off with the stored goods and nesting among the crates. Fearing the valuable dwarven gear would either be wrecked in an all-out assault by the Mountaineers or ruined by the scavengers, the league relies on bold adventurers to venture inside and haul the crates back to safety.
